concerns.text: Task T047 implements a 'Stabilization Phase' with a low-learning-rate pass to simulate biological consolidation. The spec (US-1, Edge Cases) defines the memory mechanism as a static 8x8 grid with FIFO eviction. The spec explicitly defers 'explicit binding architectures' and 'Synaptic Plasticity' (Limitations). T047 introduces a secondary training phase and weight-update rule not authorized by the spec, violating FR-001's scope and constituting a scope creep that alters the experimental subject.

Task T033 implements a 'Stability under Interference' benchmark measuring recall after injecting competing context sequences. The spec (US-3, FR-011) strictly defines the structural metric as 'interference distance' via semantic similarity < 0.2 and adjacent grid coordinates. T033 introduces a new metric and experimental protocol (competing context sequences) not defined in the spec, diluting the primary hypothesis test and violating the constraint to measure only the defined structural correlates.

Task T034 adds an 'auxiliary position-encoder regularizer' (L2 norm of coordinate gradients) to the loss function. The spec (FR-001, Limitations) defines coordinate assignment via 'Learned Embedding Lookup' and explicitly states 'explicit binding architectures are deferred'. T034 introduces an architectural modification (regularization term) not present in the spec, changing the model's optimization objective and violating the constraint to implement only the defined spatial memory mechanism.

Task T043 requires defining 'Synaptic Plasticity' and 'Recall Stability under Decay' mechanisms. The spec (Limitations) explicitly states: 'explicit binding architectures are deferred to future work' and 'Synaptic Plasticity' is not part of the current scope. Defining these mechanisms now contradicts the spec's explicit scope boundaries and introduces concepts that are not testable within the current experimental design.

Task T006 mandates implementing 'DistilGPT2' as a 'primary fallback' when memory limits are exceeded. The spec (Assumption A-003, FR-003) assumes 'gpt2-medium' fits with 4-bit quantization and prescribes only 'dataset capping' or 'batch size reduction' as mitigation. Introducing a different model architecture (DistilGPT2) changes the baseline comparison and the experimental subject, violating the 'Single Source of Truth' principle regarding the model being tested.

Task T030 requires documenting a formal mapping function $f: (x,y) 	o 	ext{AttentionHead}$. The spec (FR-001, Limitations) defines the mechanism as 'Learned Embedding Lookup based on content' and explicitly defers 'explicit binding architectures'. The task forces a specific architectural detail (direct attention head mapping) that the spec has explicitly excluded, violating the constraint to implement only the defined soft-addressed retrieval mechanism.

Tasks T025 and T026 define output paths as `artifacts/results/slot_occupancy_epoch_{epoch}.csv` and `artifacts/results/coordinate_variance_epoch_{epoch}.csv`. The spec (FR-008, FR-009) and plan (Phase 2.2) require logging these metrics to `artifacts/metrics/` (implied JSON). The mismatch in directory and format breaks the 'Single Source of Truth' data lineage required by Constitution Principle IV and the spec's artifact structure.
